title: Arise and Shine Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Arise and Shine is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 36 EAST RUSKIN STREETA Boutique Seaside Retreat Steps from the BeachIntroducing Arise & Shine, an exclusive guest cottage to the prestigious main residence, Our Place in the Sun, now offered for the very first time within Seaside’s rental portfolio. Perfectly positioned just 381 feet from the beach via a private sandy footpath and one block from Seaside Town Center, this refined coastal escape places the very best of Seaside, Florida right outside your door. With more than 40 boutiques, cafés, and award-winning restaurants within steps, Arise & Shine delivers the quintessential 30A beach lifestyle in an intimate, thoughtfully designed setting.Private Arrival & Elevated Outdoor LivingGuests enjoy the ease of private, off-street parking and a quiet rear entry accessed by a deck overlooking lush, tree-shaded pathways. Bar seating for two creates a peaceful perch for morning coffee or evening cocktails, offering a tranquil counterpoint to Seaside’s lively town center just moments away.Queen Suite with Custom DesignThe main level features a beautifully appointed queen bedroom suite, designed with both comfort and efficiency in mind. Custom built-ins, dual closets, under-bed storage, and individually lit bedside reading sconces maximize space and functionality. A wall-mounted flat-screen TV enhances in-room comfort, while the en-suite bathroom includes a sleek single vanity and a frameless glass walk-in shower for a clean, modern feel.Light-Filled Living & Balcony ViewsUpstairs, the second level opens into an airy, sun-drenched living space surrounded by windows on every side. The inviting sitting area includes a queen sleeper sofa, allowing the cottage to comfortably sleep four guests, along with a bistro-style dining table ideal for casual meals.The efficiency kitchen is thoughtfully equipped with quartzite countertops, custom cabinetry, a retro-inspired Galanz under-counter refrigerator and freezer, a large-format microwave, coffee service, and curated dishware—perfect for light cooking and beach-day convenience. Step through the glass door to the open-air balcony and enjoy elevated views of Seaside’s winding sandy paths and treetops.Modern Comforts in an Unbeatable LocationAdditional highlights include a stackable washer and dryer, an outdoor shower for rinsing off after beach days, and the unmatched walkability that defines Seaside living. Blending coastal elegance with modern comfort, Arise & Shine is an ideal choice for couples or small families seeking a peaceful yet centrally located Seaside, Florida vacation rental.* 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2-night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES494 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceOnly 381 feet from beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion, part of the largest private residential beaches on Scenic Highway 30APrivate driveway parking for one vehicle at the guest cottageOutdoor showerStackable washer and dryerEfficiency kitchen with under-counter refrigerator/freezer (no stovetop, oven, or dishwasher)Access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued; golf carts are considered vehicles and are prohibited for non-homeowners (permits required for medical needs)No pets permitted
